description: réseau routier en 1950 de 4 communes de la Réunion is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. 1950 road represents the road network in a coastal strip of approximately 100 m from the four study municipalities of Réunion: Saint-Denis, the Port, Saint-Paul and Saint-Pierre. This data was also created for 1978. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "road network in 1950 of 4 communes of Reunion" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2014-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
